comments.author: camhart
comments.story: WHO inquiry chief 'had concerns' about lab close to first Covid cases
comments.why: Used to argue Trump only said officials would look into it.
comments.text: He said they were going to look into it. He didn't break trust with your example because he didn't make a statement of fact that it was a cure. He said they'd look into it. Now if all you do is read the title of articles or videos from left leaning news site, you may walk away with the belief that he's telling people to inject it. But he's not. He says they're going to look into it. Watch the video for yourself (and take note at the video title): [VIDEO] . I want to add--I'm in no way indicating the right leaning news sites don't do the same. They've both screwed the country up by failing to report news without some bias slapped all over everything.
